fusions.name: Chitin Haymaker
fusions.desc: A punch that deals 14 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. The locusts on your fist then leap to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 50% of that.

fusions.name: Flung Handful
fusions.desc: Flings 3 fistfuls of locusts at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage, with a 30% chance per hit to leave the target [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Chest-Beating Drone
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 6 seconds. For 8 seconds, an escort of locusts fights beside you, striking for 3 damage every second.

fusions.name: Provoked Troop
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. Each kill restores 3 health to you.
